title: The Library's Titles shelf can be scrolled into view in a crowded dock
goal: In a short window with a clip's Time, Captions and Transitions sections open, the Library's Components shelf (now led by the title tiles) sits below the dock's last scroll position with no tiles showing, so a person cannot reach the titles without folding other sections. The dock should scroll far enough to show at least one whole row of the shelf, as it does for the shorter Media shelf.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-03 while building title-page-and-name-card-presets-are-tiles-on-th. Walk title-presets-library-shelf-walk, with the Midnight double click moved AFTER the two Sunrise drops (timeline grown with Scale lanes, dock crowded): Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/title-presets-library-shelf-walk.json --no-build -> step 46 (press): scrolled 858pt and a press still could not land: "Midnight" is 100pt below the bottom of the part of its own scrolling area that is on screen, and that area would not scroll any further. Capture 4-let-go-on-a-free-track-sc.png of that run shows the dock at its end with the Library ending at its search box. Logged numbers from LibraryPanel in that state: shelf 160 tall, dockCeiling 160, floor 160 (the budget's floor binds), natural 256, grouped [9,5]. Same state with the Media scope (one tile, natural 112, no squeeze) revealed its tile fine after scrolling 81pt. So the dock's outer scroll seems to fall short exactly when the shelf's floor binds; look at DockHeightBudget.overflow vs what InspectorPanel lays out for .library (listExtras + ceiling). The shipped walk avoids it by double clicking before the drops.
acceptance: With a recording open, a title page placed on the timeline and the Library on Comps, scrolling the dock to its end shows a whole row of title tiles
A walk reveals and double clicks a title tile by the pointer in that state
The Media shelf in the same state still reveals its tiles

log.note: Reproduced with the walk's Midnight double click moved after the drops: step failed 'scrolled 1083pt ... would not scroll any further'. But wheeling the dock to its end by hand (scrollPanel -3000) showed a whole row of title tiles and the double click landed: the DOCK was never short. Instrumented the harness reveal: with the dock at its top only 3pt of the shelf showed above the dock's edge; the reveal turns the innermost scroller first, so it slid the 106pt tile back and forth inside the shelf (-127, +234, six rounds) and never turned the dock. The original note's capture was taken at the dock's top, before any scrolling, which is why it looked like the Library ended at its search box.

Fix: PlaytestReach.turns (PhotonzCore, unit tested) decides which scroller turns; a strip shorter than the control never takes the turn, so the dock does. Walk title-presets-library-shelf-walk gains a fifth test (Midnight double clicked by the pointer in the crowded dock, scrolled 102pt; dock at its end photographed with a whole title row; Media tile revealed after 176pt). No app UI changed, so no audit: nothing new for a person to try. Scripts/test.sh green (11200 tests); library-shelf-height, shelf-tile-reveal, library-reveal, effects-fit-one-open walks ok.

The dock was never short: the walk harness's reveal turned a 3pt sliver of the Library shelf instead of the dock. PlaytestReach.turns (core, tested) now skips a scroller strip shorter than the control. title-presets-library-shelf-walk adds the crowded-dock case: Midnight double clicked by the pointer (scrolled 102pt), dock at its end shows a whole title row (7-crowded-dock-at-its-end-sc.png), Media tile revealed (176pt). Scripts/test.sh green; 5 reveal walks ok. Commit ab12e54a.
